caption: The drawing depicts three views of an object consisting of an oval-shaped container with a padded, segmented base. The largest view, located in the top left quadrant, shows the container in a perspective view. The container is shaded in a light green color and appears to have a slightly flared rim. Inside, it contains delicate lace or textile items with floral and leaf motifs rendered in fine line work. The container sits atop a cushion-like base with multiple rounded segments drawn in light lines. Below this, to the right, are two smaller line-drawn views: one shows the object from above, emphasizing the circular, sectioned design of the base; the other shows the object from a top-down perspective, focusing on the contents and the rim, which appears slightly transparent to reveal the lacy items inside. The background is plain and uncolored, and the composition is sparse with the objects arranged across the upper center and lower right of the image.
title: Hat
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
